name: Crossley telescope
scope: The Crossley telescope’s observatory dome, drum and attached exterior volumes at Lick Observatory on Mount Hamilton as photographed in August 2019.

originalReview.notes: Distant August 2019 photograph inspected at native resolution. The pale segmented near-hemispherical dome has a small summit track and sits over a pale stucco drum with a narrow sash. Attached volumes have low profiles. The dry hillside and access grade are visible.

review.method: Exact Qualla original and named native public-domain release
review.notes: The exact 2019 Qualla original matches the native Commons file and Thomson200 applies CC0 as uploader and photographer. The 2002 photos credit a named photographer under a different account name and were excluded from the modeling reference set because their author release could not be independently confirmed.
